body: OpenAI, and our strategic partners, are thrilled about our shared vision for the Infrastructure of AGI. We are energized by the challenges we face and are excited by the prospect of partnering with firms across the industrial base to deliver against our ambitious mission. Specifically, we want to connect with firms across the built data center infrastructure landscape, from power and land to construction to equipment, and everything in between.
summaryZh: OpenAI与其战略合作伙伴正在积极推进AGI基础设施项目（如Stargate计划），并公开向全球数据中心建设、电力供应、土地资源及硬件设备等产业链上下游企业寻求合作，以满足未来超大规模AI计算的基础设施需求。
